hook: Corporate loan applications come with a mountain of documents. Waaay too many to review, for a single case.
waiting: A loan officer can spend over an hour on the details, while the customer waits for any news of approval.
tamper: And when a bad actor slips in an edit, the smallest changes are the hardest to catch.
portal: So that's why we built... the G-L-D-B Anomaly Detection Portal. Its agents read every document in the case, and flag what doesn't add up.
upload: Start by uploading the documents. Each one is classified, and its key fields extracted, even from scans.
detect: A lead agent plans the investigation. Specialists check metadata, fonts, alignment, totals, spelling, and whether the documents agree, so a doctored figure or mismatched address gets caught.
trace: And it's not a black box. The agent trace shows every step and every tool it ran, so every finding can be audited.
score: Every case gets a risk rating, with the evidence behind it: what was flagged, where, and why. Officers confirm or dismiss each finding, add notes, and see which documents would settle any doubt.
finalise: When the review is done, they lock the case.
dashboard: And the dashboard shows every case at a glance: the pipeline, the common flags, and the riskiest cases first.
difference: Hours of screening, down to minutes. Your officers make the call, and customers hear back sooner.
cta: Bring your next loan case, and see what the portal catches. Try the G-L-D-B Anomaly Detection Portal today.
